name: Next.js (apps/web)
test: pnpm -C apps/web exec vitest run src/tests/api
pnpm -C apps/web exec vitest run --config vitest.trpc.config.ts
evidence: Turborepo monorepo; the deployable app is apps/web (Next.js App Router), deployed on Vercel.
Vite/vitest are dev dependencies used for unit tests only, so automatic detection misreads this as a Vite app and polls port 5173.
apps/web/package.json: dev and start both bind -p 3000.
/api/health returns {ok:true} and is the cheapest readiness probe (no DB or Redis dependency).
Test phase runs the real unit suites; the repo has no single script that covers both vitest projects.

Known pre-existing failures outside these suites: src/tests/app/og-route.test.ts, src/tests/components/mascot/use-mascot-state.test.tsx, src/tests/utils/announcement-storage.test.ts, src/tests/utils/yue-chat-storage.test.ts.
